disabled.Description: Indicates whether the webhook is disabled.

display_name.Description: The human-readable name of the webhook, unique within the agent.

enable_spell_correction.Description: Indicates if automatic spell correction is enabled in detect intent requests.

enable_stackdriver_logging.Description: Determines whether this agent should log conversation queries.

generic_web_service.Description: Configuration for a generic web service.

allowed_ca_certs.Description: Specifies a list of allowed custom CA certificates (in DER format) for HTTPS verification.

request_headers.Description: The HTTP request headers to send together with webhook requests.

uri.Description: Whether to use speech adaptation for speech recognition.

name.Description:
The unique identifier of the webhook.
Format: projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/agents/<Agent ID>/webhooks/<Webhook ID>.

parent.Description:
The agent to create a webhook for.
Format: projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/agents/<Agent ID>.

security_settings.Description: Name of the SecuritySettings reference for the agent. Format: projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/securitySettings/<Security Settings ID>.

service_directory.Description: Configuration for a Service Directory service.

generic_web_service.Description: The name of Service Directory service.

allowed_ca_certs.Description: Specifies a list of allowed custom CA certificates (in DER format) for HTTPS verification.

request_headers.Description: The HTTP request headers to send together with webhook requests.

uri.Description: Whether to use speech adaptation for speech recognition.

service.Description: The name of Service Directory service.

start_flow.Description: Name of the start flow in this agent. A start flow will be automatically created when the agent is created, and can only be deleted by deleting the agent. Format: projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/agents/<Agent ID>/flows/<Flow ID>.
